meta.title: Why Traveling to Vietnam Is WORTH IT - 7 Day Northern Vietnam Travel Guide & Tips 2023
meta.description:
Join us as we escape the stress of city life and explore the breathtaking nature of Northern Vietnam during a week-long vacation. With renowned UNESCO World Heritage sites like Trang An and Ha Long Bay, as well as stunning rice terraces and enchanting ancient villages in Sa Pa, Vietnam offers a unique and unparalleled travel experience. Come with us as we show you the perfect 7 day itinerary through Northern Vietnam so you can see for yourself why it is SO worth it to visit Vietnam!

0:00 Intro
1:10 Why We Picked Vietnam 
1:33 Travel to Vietnam 
2:12 Travel to Ninh Binh & Hoa Lư Ancient Capital
3:10 Trang An
3:54  Hang Mua Cave
4:57 Travel & First Day on HaLong Bay Cruise
5:39 How to Select a Cruise on Ha Long Bay
6:42 Day 2 Ha Long Bay
7:30 Cát Bà Island
8:24 Fishing Village 
10:00 Exploring Hanoi
10:37 Hanoi Food Tour
11:44 Overnight Train to Sa Pa - Chapa Express
13:02 Topaz Ecolodge in Sapa
13:34 Cat Cat Village
15:17 Hike Through Rice Terraces
17:00 Closing Thoughts on Vietnam

comments.author: @freeman-1776
comments.text: I have lived in Ha Long bay for 6 years. I am an American teaching English here.  I use a flycam (Drone) every waking moment to capture it's beauty but though I have seen many good videos and have some pretty good stuff on my own You tube channel, I think this is the best video about Northern Vietnam I have seen yet.  Well done. I have been to Hanoi, Sapa, Hue, Saigon, and Ninh Binh. You have captured the best of the best. It is now July 2024 and I am taking my Vietnamese Fiancé and her son back to the USA. I will leave in September. This video made me realize just  how much I will miss this dream world.  It truly is paradise but now it's time to take a bit of paradise back to the states.  I will miss this place with every fiber of my being. But now it's time for me to allow my new family to experience their newly found world.   Cheers!

comments.text: Mt. Fansipan, often referred to as the "Roof of Indochina," is a major attraction for those visiting Sapa. At 3,147.3 meters (10,326 feet), it offers breathtaking views and a great sense of achievement for hikers. There are different ways to reach the summit, including a cable car for those who prefer a less strenuous journey. If you enjoy trekking and outdoor adventures, climbing Fansipan is definitely a must-do.

Man, this is a beautifully filmed video and perfectly paced in narrative and information.  Our family went to VN July 2022 and we loved it as well.  We have 2 tech & screen crazy teenagers but we caught them sitting on the cruise ship balcony staring out into Halong Bay for 15 min straight without saying a word, just totally taken in by its grandeur and beauty.  We are talking about saving up vacation days (yes, we're Americans) and money to go again next year.  

BTW, your aerial shots of the Halong Bay, Ninh Binh and Sapa rice terrace is gorgeous.  I also have to give you credit for pointing out the artist like skills of the Vietnamese eateries.  If we go to a restaurant here in the US with that of food preparation, we'd have to pay out of our ears to get that kind of food.
